en-us.title: Frums - swallow SMOKE Charting Finished, VFX is WIP
en-us.content:
The charting for Frums - swallow SMOKE is now complete, and team members llllaio, PoFic, and Larus_ are currently working on the visual effects. We are excited to share more updates as we progress!

In the meantime, you can check out the pure chart on Bilibili.

en-us.title: Original Level in the Works
en-us.content: We are currently working on an original level, which is expected to be released in Q3, 2026. Stay tuned for more updates!

en-us.title: New Website Launched, and Happy International Woman Day!
en-us.content:
We are excited to announce the launch of our new website! The new site features a modern design and improved user experience. Some useful tools, resources, links, and information are now available right here.

This site is still under development, so please check back soon for more updates!

Additionally, we want to wish all the wonderful women out there a happy International Woman Day!
